prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1334; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe incident you reported in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sure. I'd rather not put my full name on it, so just treat me as the driver of the gray sedan.

Q: That's acceptable for the file. Can you walk me through what happened before the contact?

A: I was in the middle lane on a fairly busy road, planning to move over to exit. I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and signaled. As I started to merge, a pickup that had been behind me in the left lane pulled up alongside and its side panel scraped against my passenger door.

Q: Did you see the pickup before you began your lane change?

A: Not clearly. It was in my blind spot, and I didn't catch it when I glanced over. I should have turned my head fully, and I'll own that.

Q: Understood. Did the driver of the pickup stop?

A: They slowed down, then kept going for a bit before pulling onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and took a few photos at the scene.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the incident?

A: My lower back is pretty sore. It tightened up that evening, and I've been having trouble sitting for long periods. I went to urgent care the next day and they told me it looked like a muscle strain. I've been doing stretches and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you seen a physician since then, or started any treatment?

A: I have a follow-up scheduled with my primary care doctor, and I've been referred to physical therapy. I'm hoping to start that soon.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?

A: Only that I'm sorry the other driver's truck got damaged too. I just want this sorted out fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
